name: The Ritz-Carlton Naples, Tiburon
insider_take: This Mediterranean-inspired golf resort sits on 300 pristine acres where championship golf meets Gulf Coast luxury, just minutes from Naples' world-class beaches and shopping.
whats_special: Home to two Greg Norman-designed championship golf courses, The Ritz-Carlton Golf Resort features the exclusive Tiburon Golf Club where PGA Tour events are held. The resort's stunning Mediterranean architecture overlooks pristine fairways, while the world-renowned Ritz-Carlton Spa offers treatments inspired by the natural Florida landscape.
pro_tip: Book tee times early for the Black Course - it's where the PGA Tour's QBE Shootout takes place and offers some of the most challenging and scenic holes in Southwest Florida.
dont_miss: The nearby Naples Pier at sunset for dolphin watching, world-class shopping at Waterside Shops just 5 minutes away, and the pristine beaches of Vanderbilt Beach, consistently ranked among America's best beaches and just a short drive from the resort.
pros: Championship golf course designed by Greg Norman
Luxurious spa with comprehensive wellness treatments
Multiple fine dining restaurants with diverse cuisines
Prime Naples location with easy beach and downtown access
